title: Page 7
content_zh:
马叔是个刑警，有一次在派出所看见因为打架被员警训话的他，因此认识了赵廷汉。
马叔很照顾他，看得出来赵廷汉本性不坏，而且身强体壮、身手矫健，因此把他带在身边逼他好好念书。
在马叔的潜移默化下，赵廷汉对警察工作感到兴趣，高中毕业后就考上警大。
但是马叔因为调查问忠帮的犯罪事证时，遭到刘兆设计杀害，从此，傲辰与他一直想着要报仇。
他努力锻炼自己，让自己成为一位优秀的警察；而傲辰从法律系毕业后，考上了国家考试，当上检察官。
当傲辰向他提议由他卧底进入问忠帮时，他二话不说就答应了——为了报答马叔，多危险的地方他都要去闯。
他隐姓埋名，以刘伟强为假名混进了问忠帮，一步步向上爬升。为此，他干过很多坏事，杀人，走私毒品，他都掺一脚。
他告诉自己，没关系，只要能为马叔报仇，都好；如果没有马叔，他……不可能履行对明慧的承诺……不要真的当个流氓！
上星期的枪战中，他穿上了防弹背心，由傲辰帮他安排一名警察，对准他的胸口开枪，只由这个警察专朝胸口开枪。
当然，子弹都被防弹背心挡住了！
他知道自己这个脱身的招数很险，不但要看自己的演技，更要看自己的运气，幸好当时警方的火力已经减缓，那名配合开枪的警察枪法也不差，不然他没有防弹背心可以阻挡的地方还是可能中弹，进而身亡。
他非得这样做不可，只有让刘伟强死在那场枪战中，道上的人才能忘掉这个人，他赵廷汉才能真正脱险。
所以一开始他就知道，刘伟强非死不可！这是他与傲辰的共识——只有让刘伟强死掉，将来如果问忠帮还有余众，他才不会遭到报复，他如果要展开新生活，这着险棋非走不可。
“刘兆定罪的机率有多高？”
马傲辰想了想，“我不敢说百分之百，毕竟对方也是会找律师辩护，在法庭上什么意外都可能发生。但根据你收集的证据，应该九成跑不掉。”
“所以……应该可以告慰马叔在天之灵了。”
马傲辰红了眼眶，叹口气，“是啊……我想爸，会很高兴的。”
赵廷汉问着，“还有一个人，你别忘了。”
“谁？”
“刘伟强的老婆，刘静之。”

马傲辰声音很冷，“刘伟强已经死了！”那句话听来特别刺耳。
赵廷汉笑了，眼前这男人妒意真强——他假扮刘伟强的这段期间，因为跟刘静之是夫妻，所以傲辰每次见到他，简直就像是醋坛子打翻一样，说话酸得很，每一句都夹枪带棍，也不想想到底是谁逼他娶刘静之的。
“静之现在住在我那里……暂时不要让她出面，她的身分……很麻烦！”马傲辰简单说着。
点点头，“你安排好，就好了。”
轻松的坐在椅子上，马傲辰看着眼前这个多年好友，“接下来有什么打算？赵警官？”
“休息一段日子，而且我还有明慧那里的关要过。”他很苦恼，但也很轻松，现在雨过天青，只要好好跟她说，她应该能懂。
虽然连他自己都觉得，这一切很离奇，很难解释，他要怎么告诉她，这个原先是个大流氓的男人，实际上是个警察。
“如果需要我出面解释，告诉我一声，我可以帮你。”
“谢了。”
马傲辰看了看桌上的文件，“你可以放假两个月，之后我再问问看警政署是否让你归建，还是调你去别的单位……”
马傲辰负责调查刘兆与问忠帮的案子，因此调了赵廷汉来帮忙，现在任务完成，应该让廷汉好好休息，同时也避避风头。
现在全世界都以为刘伟强死了，但大家都不知道，刘伟强就是赵廷汉，他必须让廷汉先低调一点，过一段时间，等大家都忘记了刘伟强这号人物后，自然也不会有人怀疑，赵廷汉跟刘伟强之间的关系。
卧底就是这一点麻烦——是他拜托廷汉冒险卧底，现在他自然要帮廷汉注意这些事情，不能让他这个好伙伴、好兄弟涉险。
“你干脆建议上面，调我去交通大队好了，这两年的生活太刺激，再多来几次，我心脏会受不了！如果只是单纯的指挥交通，开开罚车，日子应该比较好过。”
“你忍受得住吗？你要是忍受得住，我可以帮你安排喔！”
赵廷汉笑了笑，不言语。
马傲辰知道自己的兄弟，他冷静聪颖、反应迅速，绝对是在前线冲锋办案的好人才。
相信就连他自己，都不会想这么闲逸过日。“你好好休息一段时间，到时候再跟我说你打算怎么安排，如果到时候你还是有同样的规划，我就帮你。”
点点头，赵廷汉笑着，现在的他，心情轻松，完成了一个任务，他正在盘算等会儿就去找明慧，安排跟她一起出游，趁着出游再与她好好解释。
可是就在这时，电视新闻传来一则消息，一则让他震惊的消息——

上周在音乐会中当着所有观众的面昏倒的知名音乐家沈明慧，至今已经失踪五天了！
上周五沈明慧在音乐会中昏倒后，立刻被送往医院，可是当晚医院方面就发现，沈明慧不见踪影，连着几日都下落不明。
沈家已经循各种管道寻人，而沈明慧的经纪人与经纪公司虽然不愿意正面评论，但还是将沈明慧接下来在台湾、日本与南韩的演出全部取消，观众可以进行退票……
第10章(1)
清晨，深山里浓雾弥漫，早出的人身处雾中，伸手不见五指，但不过一瞬间，太阳从东方山头升起，浓雾蒸腾散去，山间蓊郁林景重现眼前。
藏身在深山中，外人难以进入之境有着一座小精舍。
出家人在此离世修行，远离尘嚣，远离一切谷世纷扰；远离诱惑，更远离生死哀痛。
偶有登山客路过，看着这间山间小屋，赞叹它的清幽，喜爱它的遗世独立，却没有人真的愿意永远留下来，永远与外界隔离。
精舍里住了几位比丘尼，她们在此修行，多年不与外界接触，在这山林里自力更生、自给自足。
在这里环境清幽，但生活并不悠闲。
为了自给自足，这里的人自己辟建小菜园种植蔬菜。这里的生活，排除了许多对外界的物质需求与欲望，在这里，可以面对最简单的自己、最真实的自己。
承认自己的卑劣、承认自己的脆弱、承认自己的孤独、承认自己……其实随时都会被击垮。
清晨六点，精舍内早已开始运作，只有在左边的小房间内，里头的人依旧安安静静的睡着。
比丘尼们完成早课，正要用早餐，这时，一人前往这间小房间，将门一张的纸，上头写满了字，旁边还有一本又一本的佛经。
上前，摇了摇睡着的人的肩膀，“明慧，该醒醒了，六点了。”
沈明慧从书桌上惊醒过来，脸上还有未干的泪痕，她茫然看看四方，终于想起自己在哪里，揉揉脸颊，让自己忙恢复精神。“谢谢你，我知道了。”
她将桌上那些上头已经抄满的纸都收起来，只留下那一叠空白的纸在桌上，另外她还将那一本一本佛经收起来，放进一旁的小柜子里。
她赶紧去刷牙洗脸，然后赶到食堂跟这里的师父一起吃饭。粗茶淡饭，全是素食，但是没关系，她已经很长一段时间食不知味了。
content_en:
Uncle Ma is a criminal policeman. Once at the police station, he saw him being scolded by a police officer for fighting, so he met Zhao Tinghan.
Uncle Ma took good care of him. He could see that Zhao Tinghan had a good nature and was strong and agile, so he took him with him and forced him to study hard.
Under Uncle Ma's subtle influence, Zhao Tinghan became interested in police work and was admitted to the Police College after graduating from high school.
However, Uncle Ma was killed by Liu Zhao while investigating the criminal evidence of the Zhong Gang. From then on, Ao Chen and him have been thinking about revenge.
He worked hard to train himself and become an excellent policeman; while Ao Chen passed the national examination after graduating from the law department and became a prosecutor.
When Ao Chen proposed to him that he should go undercover to join the Wenzhong Gang, he agreed without saying a word - in order to repay Uncle Ma, he would go to many dangerous places.
He kept his name anonymous and got into the Wenzhong Gang under the pseudonym Liu Weiqiang, and climbed up the ranks step by step. For this reason, he has done many bad things, including killing people and smuggling drugs.
He told himself that it didn't matter, as long as he could avenge Uncle Ma, that would be fine; without Uncle Ma, he... wouldn't be able to fulfill his promise to Minghui... Don't really be a gangster!
During the shootout last week, he put on a bulletproof vest, and Ao Chen helped him arrange for a policeman to shoot him in the chest. Only this policeman shot specifically in the chest.
Of course, the bullets were stopped by the bulletproof vest!
He knew that his method of escaping was very dangerous, and it not only depended on his acting skills, but also on his luck. Fortunately, the police's firepower had slowed down at that time, and the policeman who cooperated with the shooting was also good at shooting. Otherwise, he might still have been shot without a bulletproof vest to block it, and he would have died.
He had to do this. Only by letting Liu Weiqiang die in that gun battle could people on the road forget about this man, and Zhao Tinghan could truly escape from danger.
So he knew from the beginning that Liu Weiqiang had to die! This was the consensus between him and Ao Chen - only by letting Liu Weiqiang die, if there were still members of the Wenzhong Gang in the future, he would not be retaliated against. If he wanted to start a new life, he had to make this risky move.
"What is the chance of Liu Zhao being convicted?"
Ma Aochen thought for a while, "I dare not say 100%. After all, the other party will also find a lawyer to defend him, and any accident may happen in court. But based on the evidence you collected, it should be 90% impossible to escape."
"So... I should be able to comfort Uncle Ma's spirit in heaven."
Ma Aochen's eyes turned red and he sighed, "Yeah... I think Dad will be very happy."
Zhao Tinghan asked, "There is another person, don't forget."
"Who?"
"Liu Weiqiang's wife, Liu Jingzhi."
Ma Aochen's voice was cold, "Liu Weiqiang is dead!" That sentence sounded particularly harsh.
Zhao Tinghan smiled, the man in front of him was so jealous - during the period when he was pretending to be Liu Weiqiang, because he and Liu Jingzhi were husband and wife, every time Ao Chen saw him, he was as jealous as if he was jealous.
"Jingzhi is living at my place now... don't let her come forward for the time being, her identity... is very troublesome!" Ma Aochen said simply.
Nodding, "As long as you make arrangements, it'll be fine."
Sitting relaxedly on the chair, Ma Aochen looked at his long-time friend in front of him, "What are your plans next? Officer Zhao?"
"Take a rest for a while, and I still have to pass the Minghui test." He was very troubled, but also very relaxed. Now that the rain has passed, the sky is blue, and as long as he talks to her properly, she should be able to understand.
Although even he felt that all this was very bizarre and difficult to explain, how could he tell her that this man who was originally a gangster was actually a policeman.
"If you need me to explain, just tell me and I can help you."
"Thanks."
Ma Aochen looked at the documents on the table and said, "You can take two months off., I will ask the police department later if they will let you return to work, or transfer you to another unit..."
Ma Aochen was responsible for investigating the case of Liu Zhao and the Wenzhong Gang, so he transferred Zhao Tinghan to help. Now that the task was completed, Tinghan should be allowed to have a good rest and avoid the limelight.
Now the whole world thinks that Liu Weiqiang is dead, but no one knows that Liu Weiqiang is Zhao Tinghan. He must let Tinghan keep a low profile first. After a while, when everyone forgets about Liu Weiqiang, no one will doubt the relationship between Zhao Tinghan and Liu Weiqiang.
This is the trouble with being an undercover agent - he asked Tinghan to take risks and go undercover. Now he naturally has to help Tinghan pay attention to these things and not let his good partner and brother be in danger.
"You might as well suggest that I be transferred to the traffic brigade. Life in the past two years has been too exciting. If it happens a few more times, my heart won't be able to bear it! If you just direct traffic and issue traffic penalties, your life should be easier. "
"Can you bear it? If you can bear it, I can help you arrange it! "
Zhao Tinghan smiled and said nothing.
Ma Aochen knows his brother. He is calm, intelligent, and quick to respond. He is definitely a good talent who rushes to handle cases on the front line.
I believe that even he himself would not want to live such a leisurely life. "You should have a good rest for a while, and then tell me how you plan to arrange it. If you still have the same plan by then, I will help you. "
Nodding, Zhao Tinghan smiled. Now he was in a relaxed mood and had completed a task. He was planning to go to Minghui later and arrange a trip with her, and explain it to her while they were out.
But at this moment, a piece of news came from the TV news, a piece of news that shocked him——
Shen Minghui, a well-known musician who fainted in front of the entire audience during a concert last week, has been missing for five days!
After Shen Minghui collapsed during the concert last Friday, she was immediately sent to the hospital. However, that night, the hospital discovered that Shen Minghui was missing and her whereabouts were unknown for several days.
The Shen family has been searching for people through various channels. Although Shen Minghui's agent and management company are unwilling to comment positively, they have still canceled all Shen Minghui's subsequent performances in Taiwan, Japan and South Korea. Audiences can refund their tickets...
Chapter 10(1)
In the early morning, there is thick fog in the deep mountains. Those who came out early are trapped in the fog and cannot see their fingers. But in just a moment, the sun rises from the eastern mountains, the thick fog evaporates, and the lush forest scenery of the mountains reappears before our eyes.
There is a small monastery hidden deep in the mountains, inaccessible to outsiders.
Monks leave the world to practice here, away from the hustle and bustle of the world, away from all the troubles of the world; away from temptation, and far away from the sorrow of life and death.
Occasionally, hikers pass by and look at this mountain hut, praising its tranquility and loving its isolation from the world, but no one really wants to stay and be isolated from the outside world forever.
There are several bhikshunis living in the monastery. They practice here and have no contact with the outside world for many years. They are self-reliant and self-sufficient in this mountain forest.
The environment here is quiet, but life is not leisurely.
In order to be self-sufficient, people here build their own small gardens to grow vegetables. Life here excludes many material needs and desires from the outside world. Here, you can face the simplest and truest self.
Admit one's own despicability, admit one's fragility, admit one's loneliness, admit oneself... in fact, you will be defeated at any time.
At six o'clock in the morning, operations had already begun in the monastery. Only in the small room on the left, the people inside were still sleeping peacefully.
The bhikkhunis had finished their morning classes and were about to have breakfast. At this time, one person went to this small room and opened the door to a piece of paper with words written on it. There were Buddhist scriptures one after another next to them.
He stepped forward and shook the sleeping man's shoulders, "Minghui, it's time to wake up, it's six o'clock. "
Shen Minghui woke up from the desk,There were still tears on her face. She looked around blankly, finally remembered where she was, rubbed her cheeks, and tried to regain her energy. "Thank you, I understand."
She put away all the papers on the table that were already full of copies, leaving only the blank stack of papers on the table. In addition, she also put away the Buddhist scriptures one by one and put them in a small cabinet nearby.
She hurriedly brushed her teeth and washed her face, and then rushed to the cafeteria to eat with the master here. It was a simple meal, all vegetarian, but it didn't matter, she had not tasted food for a long time.
